lines.text: After Jehoiada died, Judah's officials paid homage to the king, and Judah abandoned the house of the LORD for idols.
The LORD sent prophets, but the people would not listen, so the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah, son of Jehoiada.
By order of the king, they stoned Zechariah in the courtyard of the house of the LORD, and he asked the LORD to forgive Joash.
In the spring, the army of Aram entered Judah and sent the plunder to their king in Nineveh.
Joash's own servants killed him on his bed, he was buried in the City of David, and his son Amaziah reigned.
